title: MFA 2FA login verification code loop on iOS mobile app
description: Since the v2.4 upgrade yesterday, entering the 6-digit authenticator code redirects back to the login screen without error message. Cannot access mobile queue during field shifts.
original_text: Since the v2.4 upgrade yesterday, entering the 6-digit authenticator code redirects back to the login screen without error message. Cannot access mobile queue during field shifts.
priority_description: High urgency — repeated login failure following system deployment.
root_cause_summary: Session cookie same-site attribute mismatch on mobile Safari webview after deployment.
ai_suggested_response:
Dear Bob,

Thank you for reporting this issue. Our mobile team has identified the cookie token bug on v2.4 iOS webviews. A patch release (v2.4.1) is deploying now. In the meantime, clearing Safari cache resolves the loop.

Best regards,
SentriMail Technical Support
